meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Perform a structured security and quality audit on source code. Use when asked to review code, audit a pull request, check for vulnerabilities, or assess code quality.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码安全与质量，发现漏洞和坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在合并代码前做安全与质量把关
copy.tagline_en: Audit source code for security and quality issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to review code for vulnerabilities and quality before merging

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会逐行读取源代码，依次进行安全（OWASP Top 10）、逻辑和风格审查，最终输出带严重等级（严重/高/中/低）的 JSON 报告，包含文件、行号和描述。
howto.when: 当用户要求审查代码、审计 Pull Request、检查漏洞或评估代码质量时触发。

say.text: 审查这段代码，查找 SQL 注入漏洞。
审计这个 PR，检查逻辑错误和风格问题。
检查代码中是否有硬编码密钥。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will read every source file line by line, perform sequential security (OWASP Top 10), logic, and style audits, and output a structured JSON report with severity levels (critical/high/medium/low) including file, line, and description.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to review code, audit a pull request, check for vulnerabilities, or assess code quality.

say_en.text: Review this code for SQL injection vulnerabilities.
Audit this PR for logic errors and style issues.
Check the code for hardcoded secrets.
